component.name: MDowser
component.summary: Browse text/markdown over HTTPS and local files

description.p: MDowser is a native desktop browser for the plain-text web. Paste an HTTPS URL or open a local Markdown file and it fetches or reads it, parses it once and renders it with a clean, desktop-browser-style UI.

It is deliberately small and auditable: one document format, one HTTP method, one network protocol. There is no webview, no JavaScript, no cookies and no proxy; repeat visits use a bounded, encrypted local HTTP cache that can be cleared or disabled at any time.

ul.li: Native Markdown rendering: CommonMark plus GFM-style tables, footnotes, tasklists, YAML frontmatter, code cards with syntax colors.
MDX/JSX components (Tabs, Accordion, Card, Steps, CodeGroup, Badge) and ::: custom containers render natively; nothing is ever executed.
Real browser chrome: vertical tab rail, address autocomplete (bookmarks, local history, curated list), encrypted local history and bookmarks, zoom, light/dark theme.
Encrypted, bounded HTTP cache for documents, images and favicons, with per-class clearing and a forget-on-exit mode.
Color emoji, CJK and RTL scripts, and PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/JPEG XL/AVIF/ICO/static SVG images, all decoded in pure Rust.
Private by design: HTTPS only, GET only, local files only from user input.
